description: Source code for the IsolationInfo class and related functions in the net namespace, handling security and origin isolation logic in Chromium.

classes.name: IsolationInfo
classes.description: Represents security and origin isolation information for network requests, including request type, origins, site for cookies, and related security tokens.

methods.name: CreateForInternalRequest
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo instance for internal requests with a specified top frame origin.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient (ephemeral) IsolationInfo with opaque origins.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an IsolationInfo object from a string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo with specified request type, origins, site for cookies, party context, and nonce.

methods.name: DoNotUseCreatePartialFromNak
methods.description: Creates a partial IsolationInfo from a NetworkAnonymizationKey, used internally.

methods.name: CreateIfConsistent
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo if the provided parameters are consistent.

methods.name: CreateForRedirect
methods.description: Creates a new IsolationInfo for a redirect to a new origin.

methods.name: frame_origin
methods.description: Returns the optional frame origin associated with the IsolationInfo.

methods.name: frame_origin_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the frame origin for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsEqualForTesting
methods.description: Checks if this IsolationInfo is equal to another, for testing.

methods.name: ToDoUseTopFrameOriginAsWell
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo using an incorrectly used frame origin.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the IsolationInfo into a string.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable debug string of the IsolationInfo.

methods.name: CreateNetworkAnonymizationKeyForIsolationInfo
methods.description: Creates a NetworkAnonymizationKey based on the isolation info's origins and nonce.
